description: This iDesignRES dataset supplies inputs for the Multi-Gas Model for the Energy Transition (MGET), with Spain as the central gas system. Its described coverage includes Spain and Portugal and French border regions connected to Spain by natural-gas pipelines. One Algerian and one Moroccan region allow pipeline-import modelling. Rotterdam and the area around Marseille are included for export scenarios. Zenodo version 1.0, published on 12 February 2025, lists an XLSX workbook and a PDF data description. The provider explicitly identifies the data as MGET inputs, which supports their use in gas-system flow and transition scenarios. This is a separate gas-system resource from the project’s Spanish electricity dataset. Caveats: individual workbook sheets, field definitions, units, model compatibility and present infrastructure operation have not been checked. No workbook or PDF body was downloaded. Access: free public access through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Related resources include the project community and the linked catalogue entries.
